core_obligations: Show that the quotient of the jump matrix by the local parametrix is uniformly bounded by representing it as a Cauchy integral of the boundary values and shrinking the disc if necessary (proof lines 2015-2023).
Rewrite the integrand of the statement through the decomposition of the jump matrix and the factors controlled by the matching relation (proof lines 2023-2044).

Collect the bounds for all factors, including the inverse square root growth and the exponential decay coming from the phase function at the endpoint, to estimate the integrand by an exponentially small multiple of a power of the distance to the endpoint (proof lines 2045-2048).
Integrate the resulting bound to obtain the cubic order of the statement (proof lines 2048-2049).
proof_roadmap: Uniform boundedness of the quotient by a Cauchy integral (proof lines 2015-2023).
Factor by factor bound and exponential decay (proof lines 2045-2048).
Integration and the cubic order (proof lines 2048-2049).
